meta.source: Jolpica grid and recorded classifications; circuit outcomes v1

data.definition: Selected-season recorded races only. Pole-to-win = classified wins by grid-position-1 starters / races with an identified grid-position-1 starter. Missing grids are excluded, not losses. Single-race samples describe an outcome, not a predictive probability. Tyre degradation and pit-stop delta require separate measurements.
